system.name: Cilantro

components.role: central scheduler that generates resource allocations for jobs

components.name: Performance Learners
components.role: learns a performance model from reported performance data

content.key_idea: Cilantro closes an online feedback loop: clients report performance data that scheduler-side learners turn into confidence-bounded models driving an uncertainty-aware allocation policy.
content.reading_order: Top-down inside the Cilantro Scheduler box from the Learning Modules to the Uncertainty-aware Policy and Resource Allocator, then down to the Resource Manager and the jobs below.

evidence: The scheduler generates resource allocations for jobs and the clients collect performance feedback to report to the scheduler.
We leverage these learnings to build Cilantro (Figure 3).

summary: This figure shows the architecture of Cilantro, a resource allocation system that optimizes general scheduling objectives using online performance feedback. The central Cilantro Scheduler contains Learning Modules with Performance Learners and Load Forecasters that build confidence-bounded models from performance and load data supplied by Data Loggers. These confidence bounds feed an Uncertainty-aware Policy, which also takes a User-defined Objective, and its output drives a Resource Allocator that issues Resource Allocations to a Resource Manager (Kubernetes) shown below. Each job is shown with a Cilantro Client and Job Servers; the client reports Perf Data back up to the Data Loggers, closing the feedback loop, while a row of circles and 'More Jobs' indicates other jobs sharing the same physical resources. The diagram is a nested box architecture with red text labeling the data flowing along each arrow.
